title: Christ Our Advocate, Do Not Love the World, Warning Against Antichrists

questions.question: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an ____ with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:1 (ESV): "My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous."

questions.question: He is the ____ for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the sins of the whole world.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:2 (ESV): "He is the propitiation for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the sins of the whole world."

questions.question: And by this we know that we have come to know him, if we keep his ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:3 (ESV): "And by this we know that we have come to know him, if we keep his commandments."

questions.question: Whoever says "I know him" but does not keep his commandments is a ____, and the truth is not in him,
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:4 (ESV): "Whoever says 'I know him' but does not keep his commandments is a liar, and the truth is not in him,"

questions.question: Whoever says he abides in him ought to ____ in the same way in which he ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:6 (ESV): "whoever says he abides in him ought to walk in the same way in which he walked."

questions.question: Whoever says he is in the light and ____ his brother is still in darkness.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:9 (ESV): "Whoever says he is in the light and hates his brother is still in darkness."

questions.question: Whoever ____ his brother abides in the light, and in him there is no cause for stumbling.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:10 (ESV): "Whoever loves his brother abides in the light, and in him there is no cause for stumbling."

questions.question: Do not love the ____ or the things in the ____. If anyone loves the ____, the love of the Father is not in him.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:15 (ESV): "Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him."

questions.question: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh and the desires of the eyes and pride of life—is not from the ____ but is from the world.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:16 (ESV): "For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh and the desires of the eyes and pride of life—is not from the Father but is from the world."

questions.question: And the world is passing away along with its desires, but whoever does the will of God abides ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:17 (ESV): "And the world is passing away along with its desires, but whoever does the will of God abides forever."

questions.question: Children, it is the last hour, and as you have heard that ____ is coming, so now many ____ have come. Therefore we know that it is the last hour.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:18 (ESV): "Children, it is the last hour, and as you have heard that antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have come. Therefore we know that it is the last hour."

questions.question: They went out from us, but they were not ____ us; for if they had been ____ us, they would have continued with us...
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:19 (ESV): "They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us. But they went out, that it might become plain that they all are not of us."

questions.question: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the ____? This is the antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:22 (ESV): "Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son."

questions.question: No one who denies the Son has the Father. Whoever ____ the Son has the Father also.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:23 (ESV): "No one who denies the Son has the Father. Whoever confesses the Son has the Father also."

questions.question: And this is the promise that he made to us—____ life.
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:25 (ESV): "And this is the promise that he made to us—eternal life."

key_verse_text: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
